title: WA Recovery Pro v2.0.4 — 0-Prompt Seamless Video Recording via VirtualDisplay Surface Swapping
changelog: 🎥 0-Prompt Video Recording: Seamless surface swapping between ImageReader & MediaRecorder eliminates repetitive 'Choose app to share' dialogs
⚡ Instant Capture Switch: Immediate redirection of video stream upon clicking Record Video without interrupting the MediaProjection session
📸 Continuous Screenshot Capture: Automatically swaps back to ImageReader surface upon stopping video recording
🛡️ Android 14 Compliance: Conforms to single-session MediaProjection lifecycle standards
